providerCandidates.name: ZOOM_CREATE_WHITEBOARD
providerCandidates.summary: Creates a new whiteboard for the authenticated user. Use when you need to create a blank whiteboard that can be shared and collaborated on with others. The whiteboard will be associated with the user making the API call. **Required scope:** whiteboard:write or whiteboard:write:whiteboard **Notes:** - If no name is provided, the whiteboard will be named "Untitled" - After creation, the whiteboard can be shared with collaborators using share settings

providerCandidates.name: SLACK_CREATE_CANVAS

providerCandidates.name: SALESFORCE_CREATE_NOTE
providerCandidates.summary: Creates a new note attached to a Salesforce record with the specified title and content. Does not deduplicate — identical calls create duplicate notes. High-volume creation can trigger REQUEST_LIMIT_EXCEEDED; apply exponential backoff on retries.

providerCandidates.name: SLACK_CREATE_SLACK_LIST
providerCandidates.summary: Creates a new Slack List via `slackLists.create`. Provide a `name` and, optionally, a `description_blocks` description and a `schema` of typed columns. You can instead copy an existing List's structure with `copy_from_list_id` (and its rows via `include_copied_list_records`), or enable task-tracking columns with `todo_mode`. Returns the new List's `list_id`. Requires a user token with the `lists:write` scope.

providerCandidates.name: GMAIL_CREATE_PROMPT_POST
providerCandidates.summary: Send a one-shot prompt to the Sanity Content Agent. Stateless one-shot prompt endpoint. No thread management or message persistence. Ideal for simple, single-turn interactions. Use when you need to send a single prompt and receive a response without maintaining conversation context.

providerCandidates.name: GOOGLEDOCS_CREATE_DOCUMENT_MARKDOWN

providerCandidates.name: ZOOM_UPDATE_A_MEETING

providerCandidates.name: GREENHOUSE_CREATE_USER_JOB_PERMISSION
